exact_results: For complex a,c with ||c||<=R and ||a-c||<=delta, R,delta>=0, ||a^2-c^2||<=delta*(2R+delta).

For nonnegative real r0,u0, positive sigma, complex z0 with ||z0||<=r0 and distance-variable deviations <=delta, the literal shifted numerator N=(r^2-r0^2)+(s^2-sigma^2)-(u^2-u0^2)-2z0(s-sigma) satisfies ||N||<=delta*(4r0+2sigma+2u0+3delta).
scope: These algebra estimates require no center collinearity relation and no chart identity.
The generic square estimate allows arbitrary complex centers, including zero, and delta=0 is included throughout.
No denominator is divided by, and quotient, actual coordinate map and neighborhood/radius conclusions remain separate.
No scale-uniform lower bound on sigma is assumed; its displayed positivity and delta relation suffice.
compiler_warning: One harmless unused-variable warning: explicit hR is redundant since ||c||<=R entails R>=0. First PASS source preserved.
evidence_category: Kernel-compiled explicit complex polynomial inequalities, supporting B10/B11 geometry.
cache_disclosure: Existing pinned library/prior-audit object cache and newly compiled continuation objects reused; this is not a source dependency rebuild.
